name: Global activity (PMI)
summary: J.P.Morgan global composite PMI 53.2 in October, down from 54.3 but above the 51 Watch line; no newer data by 13 Nov
state: The J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI fell to 53.2 in October from 54.3 in September, and the global manufacturing output index eased to 53.1 from 53.8 (S&P Global, 4 Nov). The reading remains well above the 51 Watch line. No newer global data were out as of 13 Nov; November flash PMIs are due later in the month.
for_you: Global business activity is still expanding, which supports trade and employment. A further slowdown would tend to show first in manufacturing-heavy and export-reliant economies.

sources.title: S&P Global — J.P.Morgan Global Composite PMI October 2026

why: Purchasing-manager surveys are the fastest read on whether the world economy is expanding or contracting.
drivers: Orders, inventories, trade policy, energy costs, credit conditions.
